issues.evidence: The V550 bridge previously blanked response_direction even when matched governed response-option semantics supplied an authoritative raw category direction; V551 then rejected otherwise applicable candidates for missing_certified_response_direction.
issues.resolution: PR #25 preserves already-governed raw response-category direction only for matched non-special direct-response rows, while leaving V551 sole owner of signed side/magnitude/projection.

issues.evidence: The old live V550 builder used a whole-map digest as response_semantics_contract_hash, while V551 exact-matches row/question-level governed packet identities against a frozen 145-key registry.
issues.resolution: PR #26 separates map content identity from semantic-contract identity and binds 236 certified active question bindings to the exact inherited 145 frozen V551 contract keys, failing closed on unresolved/conflicting live semantics.
issues.validation_note: Worker reported a focused contract harness of 13 passed / 1 skipped (Parquet engine unavailable); no respondent-backed Lesotho smoke was claimed. Afrobarometer R1 has six explicit certified contract bindings for next-smoke preflight.
